title: soft, vibrant
text: soft, vibrant. I love love love this quilt.  I wanted a back up for my AZ home with similar colors to other quilts I already own so my throws, sheets, etc still coordinate.  This quilt does it for me.  The colors are accurately represented in the sellers ad, in my opinion.  Vibrant, but not brash.  It's soft and washed up nicely. It fits nicely... remember most quilts are toppers, not "bedspreads" that usually go down further, sometimes to the floor... I prefer quilts to comforters for the washing ease.  Comes with 2 shams ( I ordered the queen size) .  I always update my reviews if any issues or other useful info comes up.
